reading.body:
Data Holdings operates a facility in Milwaukee with a verified address but publishes no power capacity or square footage on its own site, making it impossible to assess its scale for AI workloads. Wisconsin has six mapped data center facilities total, of which only one publishes power capacity, meaning this campus's actual size relative to other sites in the state remains unknown.

The facility ranks second by published megawatts in Wisconsin, but this ranking reflects the absence of published data from other sites rather than a measured position. The state's single published capacity figure is 1.6 MW across all facilities, a figure too small to support meaningful AI infrastructure at current densities, suggesting either that Wisconsin's data center fleet remains nascent, that operators do not publish specifications, or both.

Without published capacity, certifications, or grid context, this site cannot be evaluated as material to AI scaling decisions. Any assessment of its role in the state's AI infrastructure would require the operator to disclose power capacity and IT load specifications.
